result.summary: Failed transfer MSG01109 (ENC-T1/MRN-T1 to WARD-B, event 08:20Z) failed with 503 ward_unavailable. There is no receipt (404), so it was never committed. Under ELS-2.1 that later transfer supersedes the failed one, and a resend would move the patient back to a ward they have already left. The update at 08:30Z (v2, MSG01113) does not supersede a transfer (ELS-2.2). The later discharge at 09:30Z (MSG01117) also failed with 503 and was not applied, so it does not decide this case. The patient matches the encounter (MRN-T1^HOSP). The catalogue match E1 agrees (outcome none). Its correct_history alternative applies only if the site's history_policy is 'correct', and that policy is not in the evidence.
